confirmed_current_rules.daily_loss_reset: 00:30 UTC; balance at 00:30 establishes the daily reference and intraday equity is monitored in real time
confirmed_current_rules.stop_loss_execution: triggers market order when stop level is reached
confirmed_current_rules.take_profit_execution: triggers market order when target level is reached

support_rule.collection: six equal rollover charges every four hours

carry_rule_conflict.material_difference: timing and eligibility of debits can affect balance and therefore 00:30 MDL reference/equity path
carry_rule_conflict.resolution: Do not choose one interpretation post-outcome. Any proxy screen must report both legal-daily and support-4h timing envelopes. Exact PROP-COMPAT remains blocked until authoritative reconciliation.

execution_layer.environment: simulated evaluation environment intended to reflect live market conditions
execution_layer.market_order: best available price; stop/take-profit trigger market orders
execution_layer.liquidity: depth of market is material; limit orders require sufficient liquidity for full fill and partial fills are not supported in Breakout evaluation dashboard
execution_layer.proxy_policy: If a non-decisional kill-screen is run, preserve the existing DH-03 BASE/STRESS total execution-cost envelopes of 0.20%/0.30% round trip ex carry. With Kraken commission fixed at 0.08% round trip, residual execution uncertainty is 0.12% BASE and 0.22% STRESS. This is not a claim about observed Kraken historical spreads.

decision.reason: Carry timing/eligibility conflict and unavailable historical executable bid/ask/depth/fill stream prevent exact replay.
